note: Outlines (x, y in native px) of structures meeting the exclusion criteria in README.md. Drawn by Claude (not a pathologist) from the image on 2026-11-14 for the user's review; each polygon encloses the structure with its boundary in the adjacent airspace or across the septa that join it. The excluded region is the polygon intersected with the structure's hull (src/exclude.py). 'criterion' cites the README rule; 'confidence' is the annotator's certainty that the rule applies.
